I plotted monthly revenue from `data/sales.csv` as a bar chart and saved it as a PNG. I opened the image to check it, and it shows all 12 months, 2026-01 to 2026-12.

Saved to `/var/folders/h8/0f01fyr1509bx1f4qm08px7r0000gn/T/p822.hzbdoyy3/exports/monthly_revenue.png`

Revenue starts at $41.2k in January and climbs to a peak of $71.8k in December, which is labeled on the chart. There are small dips in February, June and October.

It's a single series, so there's no legend. I used one blue and didn't run the palette validator.

The plotting script is at `/tmp/p822-scripts/plot.py`, outside the repo. Run it with `python3 -I /tmp/p822-scripts/plot.py <csv> <output.png>`.
